card.line: Gibeath-haaraloth is a city where Joshua circumcised the sons of Israel at the LORD's command, after the men of war from Egypt had died.

moments.title: Joshua circumcises Israel's sons
moments.text: The LORD told Joshua to make flint knives and circumcise the sons of Israel again, and Joshua did this at Gibeath-haaraloth. These were the sons He raised up in place of the men of war who left Egypt and died because they did not obey the LORD.
